en: Illustrated vintage postcard in black and white with red text. On the left stands a bearded man in formal clothing waving his hat and holding a flagstaff topped with a wreath inscribed "Nossen 8. VII. 1906". Behind him is a large historic building complex with steep roofs and a tower, likely a castle or palace, surrounded by trees. A ribbon above bears additional text. At the bottom are two heraldic shields. The right half of the card is mostly blank except for a red German greeting printed in Gothic-style script.
